# OpenDefendable · llms.txt

Context manifest for AI agents indexing opendefendable.com.
Last updated: 2026-05-28

## What This Is

OpenDefendable is the public standards and community layer for the Defendable ecosystem.

It publishes reusable artifacts for defendable AI work:

- receipt schemas
- worker contracts
- dataset provenance patterns
- policy-pack formats
- conformance cases
- implementation notes
- public research summaries

## Ecosystem Role

- DefendableOS: commercial operating layer and product doctrine
- DefendableCloud: member-only datasets and private GPU compute
- DefendableRouter: member gate, compute meter, job router, receipt ledger
- DefendableWorker: owned-rig worker agent that leases jobs and reports results
- OpenDefendable: public specs, schemas, policy packs, and RFCs

## Core Doctrine

- Members get the datasets.
- Compute gets metered.
- Every job gets a receipt.
- Every dataset access gets a receipt.
- Every compute quote gets a receipt.
- Receipts should be structured, checksumed, inspectable, and portable.

## Current Public Specs

- https://opendefendable.com/specs/defendable-receipt-v0.1.json
- https://opendefendable.com/specs/defendable-worker-v0.2.json

## Publication Policy

OpenDefendable should publish curated, useful, source-linked public artifacts.
It should not publish raw strategy docs, private market-intel notes, customer wedge plans, pricing strategy, or unverified competitive claims.

## Current Limitations

OpenDefendable is a public standards and contribution surface. It is not yet a certification authority, insurance product, external enforcement service, or formal standards body. Hashes and checksums establish content-integrity linkage only unless paired with an external trusted timestamp, ledger anchor, or third-party attestation.
